plan.title: Verify the full application suite on Go 1.23.12 in native Linux CI

criteria.description: Execute format, vet, full race tests, cross-vet and application build with Go 1.23.12 and GOTOOLCHAIN=local on Ubuntu amd64; separately run development analysis and dogfood checks with Go 1.27.3. Require actual remote success and record exact toolchain boundaries.

limitations: Push only a dedicated ci/naru-038 branch for authorized runner validation. No main push, release or local tool installation. Analysis tools require newer Go and must not be described as Go 1.23 executions.
